description: S458 2a-fix F2 (union arm), the negative twin: a value of the unrefined non-primitive member is admitted. `pick(v: number(>0) | Role)` called with `.Editor` and `list(v: number(>0) | string[])` called with ["x", "y"] both run.
rationale: §53.3.1: a value inhabits a union by inhabiting a member; `.Editor` is a Role, ["x", "y"] is a string[].
